hold_text: Live trader reconcile path: src/runtime/order_monitor.py position-snapshot reconciler RESET-SUSPECT handling (and the local-PnL sweep's exclusion of exchange_reset_flat rows); the manager merges under the operator's NO-HALT directive 2026-10-09 ("There is no halting.")

ONE red flag per account if rows stay suspect 3 counted passes, ONE recovery announcement. The no-mass-close-on-one-read RISK-1 guard is kept.
